```{r}

# --- CREATE MODEL --- #

# Prepare data

data_for_analysis = data_for_analysis %>% 
  rename(dis_per = disturbance_percentage) %>%
  filter(trophic_type == "heterotrophic")

# Model

model = glmmTMB(shannon ~
                  size * conn * dis_per +
                  (1 | ecosystem_ID) +
                  (1 | day) +
                  (1 | baseline),
                data = data_for_analysis,
                family = tweedie(link = "log"),
                ziformula = ~ size * conn * dis_per,
                dispformula = ~ size + conn + dis_per + day,
                control=glmmTMBControl(optimizer=nlminb,
                                       optArgs=list(method="BFGS")))
```

<details>
<summary>Model residuals coding</summary>
```{r eval = (response_variable_selected == "shannon" | response_variable_selected == "evenness_pielou")}

# --- CODE MODEL RESIDUALS --- #

emmeans_output = emmeans(model,
                         specs = ~  conn * dis_per * size,
                         adjust = "sidak",
                         bias.adj = TRUE,
                         lmer.df = "satterthwaite") 

emmeans_output

uncon_decr_6_43 = c(1, rep(0,15)) 
con_decr_6_43 = c(rep(0,1), 1, rep(0,14)) 
uncon_fix_6_43 = c(rep(0,2), 1, rep(0,13)) 
con_fix_6_43 = c(rep(0,3), 1, rep(0,12)) 
uncon_decr_9 = c(rep(0,4), 1, rep(0,11)) 
con_decr_9 = c(rep(0,5), 1, rep(0,10)) 
uncon_fix_9 = c(rep(0,6), 1, rep(0,9)) 
con_fix_9 = c(rep(0,7), 1, rep(0,8)) 
uncon_decr_15 = c(rep(0,8), 1, rep(0,7))
con_decr_15 = c(rep(0,9), 1, rep(0,6))
uncon_fix_15 = c(rep(0,10), 1, rep(0,5))
con_fix_15 = c(rep(0,11), 1, rep(0,4))
uncon_decr_45 = c(rep(0,12), 1, rep(0,3))
con_decr_45 = c(rep(0,13), 1, rep(0,2))
uncon_fix_45 = c(rep(0,14), 1, rep(0,1))
con_fix_45 = c(rep(0,15), 1)

n_of_digits = 3
contrasts = contrast(emmeans_output, 
                     method = list("6.43 ml decrease % with size" = con_decr_6_43 - uncon_decr_6_43,
                                   "9.00 ml decrease % with size" = con_decr_9 - uncon_decr_9,
                                   "15.00 ml decrease % with size" = con_decr_15 - uncon_decr_15,
                                   "45.00 ml decrease % with size" = con_decr_45 - uncon_decr_45,
                                   "6.43 ml fixed % with size" = con_fix_6_43 - uncon_fix_6_43,
                                   "9.00 ml fixed % with size" = con_fix_9 - uncon_fix_9,
                                   "15.00 ml fixed % with size" = con_fix_15 - uncon_fix_15,
                                   "45.00 ml fixed % with size" = con_fix_45 - uncon_fix_45)) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(p.value = round(p.value, digits = n_of_digits),
         estimate = round(estimate, digits = n_of_digits),
         SE = round(SE, digits = n_of_digits),
         df = round(df, digits = n_of_digits),
         z.ratio = round(z.ratio, digits = n_of_digits),
         e = "",
         e = ifelse(p.value > 0.1, 
                           "",
                           e),
         e = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, 
                           "*",
                           e),
         e = ifelse(p.value < 0.01, 
                           "**",
                           e),
         e = ifelse(p.value < 0.001, 
                           "***",
                           e)) %>%
  rename(" " = e)
```

<details open="open">
<summary>Model residuals</summary>
```{r fig.width = figures_height_rmd_output}

# --- PLOT MODEL RESIDUALS --- #

simulationOutput <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = model, n = 1000)
testDispersion(simulationOutput)
plot(simulationOutput)

plotResiduals(simulationOutput, form = data_for_analysis$day)
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, form = data_for_analysis$size)
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, form = data_for_analysis$conn)
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, form = data_for_analysis$dis_per)
if(response_variable_selected == "bioarea_mm2_per_ml") {
  plotResiduals(simulationOutput, form = data_for_analysis$trophic_type)
  }

testOutliers(simulationOutput)
testZeroInflation(simulationOutput)
```
